doc_context.description: Short description of document context (e.g. MDM note, clinic letter, genomics report)
doc_context.title: Doc Context

doc_summary.description: Short summary of current cancer treatment status with focus on phase of care
doc_summary.title: Doc Summary

future_plan_summary.description: Short summary of future plan with essential facts only
future_plan_summary.title: Future Plan Summary

future_plan_desc.description: Direct extract of descriptive text for plan
future_plan_desc.title: Future Plan Desc

biomarker.description: Gene or protein biomarker. Use OTHER if specific biomarker not listed.

biomarker_name_desc.description: Name of biomarker as described in clinical text
biomarker_name_desc.title: Biomarker Name Desc

biomarker_alteration.description: Description of specific alteration (e.g. V600E, G12C)
biomarker_alteration.title: Biomarker Alteration

biomarker_expression_level.description: Description of expression level for protein markers if exists (e.g. 3+, 90% positive, 4/8)
biomarker_expression_level.title: Biomarker Expression Level

biomarker_vaf_numeric_value.description: Numeric value for variant allele frequency in %
biomarker_vaf_numeric_value.title: Biomarker Vaf Numeric Value

biomarker_vaf_desc.description: Direct extract of descriptive text for biomarker VAF
biomarker_vaf_desc.title: Biomarker Vaf Desc

biomarker_desc.description: Direct extract of descriptive text that fully describes biomarker and status, including alterations and numeric values
biomarker_desc.title: Biomarker Desc

other_topography.description: Confirmed topography of historical or concurrent cancer

other_topography_name_desc.description: Name of anatomical site as described in clinical text
other_topography_name_desc.title: Other Topography Name Desc

other_morphology.description: Confirmed morphology of historical or concurrent cancer

other_morphology_name_desc.description: Name of histological classification as described in clinical text
other_morphology_name_desc.title: Other Morphology Name Desc

other_latest_situation_summary.description: Short summary of latest situation for this cancer
other_latest_situation_summary.title: Other Latest Situation Summary

patient_finding_name_desc.description: Name of specific finding as described in clinical text
patient_finding_name_desc.title: Patient Finding Name Desc

patient_finding_desc.description: Direct extract of descriptive text for the finding
patient_finding_desc.title: Patient Finding Desc

patient_finding_status.description: Whether the specific finding is present, is not present, or is uncertain/hypothetical

ps_scale.description: Scale used for performance status if given, e.g. ECOG, Karnofsky
ps_scale.title: Ps Scale

ps_desc.description: Direct extract of descriptive text for performance status
ps_desc.title: Ps Desc

primary_cancer_tumour_facts.description: Molecular and genomic characteristics of the tumour

primary_cancer_scores.description: Specialist cancer staging or grading scores
primary_cancer_scores.title: Primary Cancer Scores

primary_cancer_spread.description: Locations of cancer spread - confirmed sites only
primary_cancer_spread.title: Primary Cancer Spread

topography.description: Most suitable anatomical site of primary cancer. Use OTHER where there is ambiguity, or no suitable found in enum.

topography_name_desc.description: Name of anatomical site as described in clinical text
topography_name_desc.title: Topography Name Desc

morphology.description: Most suitable histological classification of primary cancer. Use OTHER where there is ambiguity, or no suitable found in enum.

morphology_name_desc.description: Name of histological classification as described in clinical text
morphology_name_desc.title: Morphology Name Desc

is_recurrence.description: TRUE if the primary cancer is explicitly described as a recurrence or relapse of a previous cancer
is_recurrence.title: Is Recurrence

tnm_stage.description: Confirmed, latest, TNM staging for main cancer (e.g. T2N1bM0)
tnm_stage.title: Tnm Stage

numeric_group_stage.description: Confirmed group staging for main cancer using Roman numerals (e.g. I, IIa, IV etc)
numeric_group_stage.title: Numeric Group Stage

score.description: Name of a single specialist staging or grading measurement. Use OTHER where ambiguity or score not in enum.

score_name_desc.description: Name of a staging or grading measurement as described in clinical text
score_name_desc.title: Score Name Desc

score_value_desc.description: Direct extract of score value as described in clinical text
score_value_desc.title: Score Value Desc

spread_type.description: Most suitable type of spread. Use OTHER where ambiguity or no suitable found.

spread_site_desc.description: Name of specific metastastic site or node as described in clinical text
spread_site_desc.title: Spread Site Desc

event_summary.description: Short summary for specific event with essential facts
event_summary.title: Event Summary

event_desc.description: Direct extract of descriptive text for event
event_desc.title: Event Desc

msi_desc.description: Direct extract of descriptive text for MSI
msi_desc.title: Msi Desc

tmb_numeric_value.description: TMB numeric value in mutations/Mb if provided
tmb_numeric_value.title: Tmb Numeric Value

tmb_desc.description: Direct extract of descriptive text for TMB
tmb_desc.title: Tmb Desc

molecular_biomarker_profiles.description: Genomic alterations and protein expression findings
molecular_biomarker_profiles.title: Molecular Biomarker Profiles

document_has_primary_cancer_flag.description: TRUE if the document concerns a patient and a cancer diagnosis
document_has_primary_cancer_flag.title: Document Has Primary Cancer Flag

primary_cancer_confirmed_flag.description: TRUE = there is confirmed primary cancer diagnosis, FALSE = hypothetical/under investigation or not cancer
primary_cancer_confirmed_flag.title: Primary Cancer Confirmed Flag
